idea-plugin.name: Salam
idea-plugin.description:
Support for the Salam programming language, in English and Persian.

  • errors and warnings as you type, with the compiler's codes and help text
  • completion, hover, parameter hints and inlay type hints
  • go to definition, find usages, rename, call hierarchy and the structure view
  • semantic and TextMate highlighting, folding and formatting
  • a Salam run configuration, Run in the context menu, and a Run icon next to func main
  • tests in the IDE test tree: run a _test.salam file, a directory or one test_ function with salam test

The features come from salam lsp, the language server built into the Salam compiler, run through LSP4IJ. Install Salam first; the plugin finds it on PATH, in ~/.salam/bin, or through the SALAM_PATH environment variable.
